description: The same feature as 01-defects, written correctly: updatedAt dependency, corrections appended, unicode-scalar CSV split, borderless row buttons, one enum-driven sheet, balanced braces with braces inside a string literal. Every pitfall check has a look-alike that must not be flagged.
prompt: Review the changes in the most recent commit (git show HEAD) for correctness and report your findings.

must_not_flag.why: Reads session.updatedAt in body and bumps it on every write.
Recorded sessions only get corrections; rename is guarded.
Splits on unicode scalars; Character iteration is used only for initials.
Code braces balance; the extra brace is inside a string literal.

note: Decoys are scoped to the pitfall they imitate: a `correctness` finding on the same code is scored as unlabeled, not as a decoy hit.
